text: 10月8-9日，商务部部长王文涛在北京与欧委会贸易和经济安全委员谢夫乔维奇共同主持召开中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会并发表联合声明。双方立足“稳定、平衡的中欧关键贸易伙伴”定位，共同盘点了首次会议以来机制项下贸易和投资平衡、出口管制、知识产权、世贸组织改革四个工作板块磋商进展，并就中欧经贸重要议题进行了对等、专业、建设性的讨论。
text_en: On October 8-9, Minister of Commerce Wang Wentao and European Commissioner for Trade and Economic Security Maroš Šefčovič co-chaired the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism in Beijing and issued a joint statement. Based on the positioning of a "stable and balanced key trade partnership between China and the EU," the two sides jointly reviewed the consultation progress under the mechanism's four working areas since the first meeting—trade and investment balance, export controls, intellectual property rights and WTO reform—and held reciprocal, professional and constructive discussions on important China-EU economic and trade topics.
